meta.name: add-imessage
meta.description: Add iMessage to NanoClaw — one channel, two backends. Local (this Mac's chat.db via the Chat SDK bridge; macOS + Full Disk Access) or Hosted iMessage (via photon.codes — native spectrum-ts with a device-login wizard; any OS, no Mac relay). Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", "imessage via photon", "native imessage".

copy.tagline: 让 NanoClaw 连接 iMessage 通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在使用 NanoClaw 并希望接收 iMessage 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect iMessage to NanoClaw as a channel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and want to receive iMessage messages.

howto.what: 该技能会把 iMessage 接入 NanoClaw:复制 iMessage 适配器、安装依赖、配置环境变量并重启服务。之后机器人可以通过你的 iMessage 账号收发消息——本地模式读取这台 Mac 的聊天记录,远程模式经由 Photon 服务器。
howto.when: 当用户说出“add imessage”“connect imessage”“add photon”等触发词,或要求添加/连接 iMessage 时触发。

howto.what_en: Adds iMessage to NanoClaw: copies the adapter, registers it, installs chat-adapter-imessage, configures env, restarts. The bot then sends/receives iMessage via local macOS chat.db or remote Photon server.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", or any request to add/connect iMessage.

say_en.text: Add the iMessage channel for me.

say_en.note: Uses remote mode; needs server URL and API key.

say_en.text: Set up iMessage in local mode.
say_en.note: Requires Full Disk Access for Node on this Mac.
